rules.name: cash-refresh-11-ssv-history-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT table_name, view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND table_name IN ('helper_calculated_settle_price_view_cfs','helper_cash_balance_report_view_cfs')

SELECT trigger_name, event_manipulation, event_object_table, action_timing, created, definer, action_statement FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND event_object_table IN ('security_settlement_value_table_cfs', 'historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs') ORDER BY event_object_table, trigger_name

SELECT c.value_date, COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.derivative_type = 'fx_forward_ndf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ndf_rows FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs c LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs s ON s.security_id = c.security_id GROUP BY c.value_date ORDER BY c.value_date

SELECT h.value_date, COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.derivative_type = 'fx_forward_ndf' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ndf_rows FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs h LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs s ON s.security_id = h.security_id WHERE h.value_date >= :fromDate GROUP BY h.value_date ORDER BY h.value_date
SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE upper(trim(security_id)) = upper(trim(:securityId)) ORDER BY value_date

SELECT tablename, valuation_date, status_type, status, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM dbsystemuat.status_table WHERE tablename IN ('security_settlement_value_table_cfs','security_last_actual_value_table_cfs') AND valuation_date >= :fromDate ORDER BY valuation_date, tablename

SELECT s.security_id, s.maturity_date, cur.settle_price AS current_price, cur.value_date AS current_value_date, h.settle_price AS history_price, h.value_date AS history_value_date FROM dbsystemuat.security_info_table_cfs s LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs cur ON cur.security_id = s.security_id AND cur.value_date = :valueDate LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs h ON h.security_id = s.security_id AND h.value_date = :valueDate WHERE s.derivative_type = 'fx_forward_ndf' AND s.maturity_date >= :valueDate ORDER BY s.security_id

SELECT s.security_id, s.maturity_date, c.value_date, c.settle_price FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table s LEFT JOIN opera.security_settlement_value_table c ON c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = s.business_unit AND c.security_id = s.security_id AND c.value_date = :valueDate WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.derivative_type = 'fx_forward_ndf' AND s.maturity_date >= :valueDate ORDER BY s.security_id

SELECT s.security_id, s.maturity_date, c.value_date, c.settle_price FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table c ON c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = s.business_unit AND c.security_id = s.security_id AND c.value_date = :valueDate WHERE s.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND s.business_unit = 'CFS' AND s.derivative_type = 'fx_forward_ndf' AND s.maturity_date >= :valueDate ORDER BY s.security_id

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date

SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND upper(btrim(security_id)) = upper(btrim(:securityId)) ORDER BY value_date

SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM opera_backup_04_10.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND upper(btrim(security_id)) = upper(btrim(:securityId)) ORDER BY value_date

SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema IN ('opera','opera_backup_04_10') AND (table_name LIKE '%settlement_value%' OR table_name LIKE 'valuation_date%') ORDER BY table_schema, table_name
